## Why this file

The upstream skill is a data-cleaning specification with a complete Stata do-file skeleton: setup and logging, duplicate and missing-value handling, derived variables, `assert`-style range checks, labelling, and the final save. It is kept as reference material for `skills/data-prep/`. The upstream `index.md` file is a byte-identical duplicate of the matching `SKILL.md`, so it is not copied twice.

The file is a third-party reference document, not part of this kit's skill contract. `skills/data-prep/SKILL.md` is the only procedure that applies in this repository.
